title: 第15章 身处绝境吞服禁药第16章 虚幻身影未来之人
slug: 开局亿年修为弹指间秒杀一切
content_zh:
东荒神州。
一处山脉中，血影楼便坐落在这里。
“死了？”
“对，全死了。”
“全是废物，这么多人，竟然都能死在那小小的青州。”
“派血手去。”
“这一次，要是还查不清楚，让他不用回来了。”
“是，楼主！”
一间阴暗的大堂中，有几道交谈声缓缓传出。
很快，血影楼中便离开了一批人，大约有三十多位。
领头的那人，便是血手，血影楼的招牌杀手，实力更是达到渡劫八重。
这次死在青州的血影楼杀手足足十几人，这让血影楼的高层都很是愤怒。
血影楼建立至今，都没有人敢一次性杀他们这么多人。
这是赤裸裸的挑衅，血影楼自然不可能放这幕后之人。
不过血影楼怎么也没有想到，这幕后之人是李如风。
要是知道李如风的实力，恐怕给他们一百个胆子，他们也不敢派人去找李如风报仇。
与此同时。
青州边境，此刻有一道靓丽身影正快速朝着青州逃去。
而在她身后不远处，正有五道身影紧紧跟着她。
女子名叫楚依依，乃是缘生宗的一名弟子。

而后面紧追不舍得那五人，则是幽冥宗的人。
就在几个月前，幽冥宗暗中勾结其他宗门，直接覆灭了缘生宗。
那一战，缘生宗上下几千人，几乎全都被灭了口。
只有一些幸运儿因为外出任务而躲过这一劫。
不过为了彻底覆灭缘生宗，幽冥宗发布了一个任务。
那就是杀掉一名残存的缘生宗之人，就可以领一万下品灵石。
而楚依依便很不走运的被五名幽冥宗弟子发现了行踪，这才导致她被迫逃到青州。
但即便逃了这么远，那些幽冥宗的人丝毫没有放弃的打算。
毕竟楚依依的脑袋可是值一万下品灵石。
这对于一个普通的幽冥宗弟子来说，就是一笔不小的修炼资源，任谁也不会轻易放弃。
不仅如此，楚依依长的楚楚动人，这让幽冥宗的五人不仅想要她的命，更是想要好好把玩一番楚依依。
此刻，若不是背负着宗门被灭的血海深仇，楚依依恐怕早就放弃挣扎了。
只要一想到平时对她照顾有加的宗门弟子以及长老都死在幽冥宗之人的手中，她心中的仇恨就再一次逼迫着她继续拼命逃亡。
“幽冥宗，只要我楚依依不死，他日，我定要亲手灭了你们所有人！”
“可是，我能活过今天吗……”
content_en:
Eastern Wilds China.
In a mountain range, the Blood Shadow Tower is located here.
"Dead?"
"Yes, they are all dead."
"It's all rubbish. So many people could die in that small Qingzhou."
"Send the bloody hands."
"This time, if the investigation is still unclear, let him not come back."
"Yes, the host!"
In a dark lobby, several voices of conversation slowly came out.
Soon, a group of people left the Blood Shadow Tower, about thirty of them.
The leader is Xue Shou, the signature killer of Xue Ying Tower, whose strength has reached the eighth level of transcending tribulation.
There were more than a dozen Blood Shadow Studio killers who died in Qingzhou this time, which made the senior executives of the Blood Shadow Studio very angry.
Since the establishment of the Blood Shadow Tower, no one has dared to kill so many of them at once.
This is a naked provocation. Naturally, it is impossible for the Blood Shadow Studio to let the person behind the scenes go.
However, Xueyinglou never expected that the person behind this was Li Rufeng.
If they knew Li Rufeng's strength, they would not dare to send people to seek revenge against Li Rufeng.
at the same time.
At the border of Qingzhou, there is a beautiful figure quickly running towards Qingzhou.
Not far behind her, there were five figures following her closely.
The woman's name is Chu Yiyi, and she is a disciple of Yuansheng Sect.
The five people chasing after them were from the Netherworld Sect.
Just a few months ago, the Netherworld Sect secretly colluded with other sects and directly destroyed the Yuansheng Sect.
In that battle, almost all of the thousands of Yuan Sheng Sect members were silenced.
Only a few lucky ones escaped this fate because they were away on assignment.
However, in order to completely destroy the Yuan Sheng Sect, the Netherworld Sect issued a mission.
That is, if you kill a remaining member of Yuansheng Sect, you can receive 10,000 low-grade spiritual stones.
Chu Yiyi was unlucky enough to be discovered by five Nether Sect disciples, which forced her to flee to Qingzhou.
But even after escaping so far, those from the Netherworld Sect had no intention of giving up.
After all, Chu Yiyi's head was worth ten thousand low-grade spiritual stones.
For an ordinary Netherworld Sect disciple, this is a considerable amount of cultivation resources, and no one will give it up easily.
Not only that, Chu Yiyi's beautiful appearance made the five people from the Netherworld Sect not only want her life, but also want to play with Chu Yiyi.
At this moment, if it weren't for the blood feud that caused the sect to be destroyed, Chu Yiyi would have given up struggling long ago.
As soon as she thought of the sect disciples and elders who usually took good care of her, all died in the hands of people from the Netherworld Sect, the hatred in her heart once again forced her to continue her desperate escape.
"Netherworld Sect, as long as I, Chu Yiyi, don't die, I will definitely kill all of you with my own hands one day!"
"But, can I survive today..."
